imports.description:
A string representation of all of the imports being added dynamically.

Ex. "import { UiSdlThemeTemplate } from '@c3/types';\nimport isNil from 'lodash/isNil';\n"

importNames.description:
An array of the import names from the imports string.

Following the same example: ["UiSdlThemeTemplate", "isNil"]

title:
A type representing the return value of a `generateImport` function for a generator used by
{@link Ann#UiImportGenerator}.
name: UiSdlImportResult
